companies.name: Atexxo
companies.tagline: Explosion-proof mobile devices for hazardous areas
companies.description:
Atexxo Manufacturing is an international company specialized in the design and production of explosion-proof mobile devices with ATEX and IECEx certifications. Headquartered in the Netherlands, Atexxo converts premium Apple and Samsung devices — such as iPhones, iPads and Galaxy Tabs — into certified versions for safe use in hazardous areas, maintaining all original equipment functionality, including 5G, NFC, cameras, wireless charging, and Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connectivity.

Atexxo products are certified for ATEX Zone 1 and 2 (gas explosion risk) and Zone 21 and 22 (dust explosion risk), with international IECEx and UKCA certifications, plus INMETRO certification available for selected models. All devices preserve the full user experience, including apps, interface, performance, and ecosystem of the original device, with no loss of performance.

Designed specifically for critical industries such as oil and gas, petrochemical, offshore, and pharmaceutical, Atexxo devices are ideal for connected workers, Industry 4.0, digital twins in hazardous areas, and safe photo and video capture in dangerous environments.

companies.name: Blinda
companies.tagline: Explosion-proof equipment with international certification — the only Brazilian company authorized to use CEAG components
companies.description:
For over 60 years, Blinda has been a national reference in explosion-proof (Ex) electrical equipment, serving with excellence the oil and gas, petrochemical, steel, and mining sectors. Its portfolio encompasses junction boxes, control panels, push-button stations, cable glands, signaling devices, and a complete line of certified connections and accessories.

With INMETRO, IECEx, and ATEX certifications, Blinda is the only company in Brazil authorized to use CEAG components in its projects, ensuring an international standard of quality and safety. All products are manufactured with high-strength materials — copper-free aluminum, 304/316L stainless steel, and glass-reinforced polyester (GRP) — ensuring IP66/W protection and a temperature class from -60 °C to +110 °C.

Located in Votorantim (SP), Blinda is part of the Polar Components Group, offering complete solutions in Ex equipment for explosive atmospheres, with specialized technical support and custom manufacturing to meet the industry's most rigorous specifications.

Construction in marine-grade die-cast aluminum, stainless steel, and anticorrosive coatings, with IP66/IP67 protection. High-efficiency LED with typical service life above 100,000 hours.

companies.name: Dropsafe
companies.tagline: Global leader in dropped object prevention — protecting people, assets, and operations with passive 24/7 safety solutions
companies.description:
Dropsafe is the global leader in dropped object prevention, partnering with companies in high-risk sectors such as energy, oil and gas, mining, chemical, maritime, and renewables. With over 20 years of experience, it develops specialized solutions — nets, barriers, slings, and securing systems — to prevent objects from falling in industrial environments, ensuring safer operations and strengthening safety culture.

Unlike active solutions that rely on daily human intervention, Dropsafe adopts a passive prevention philosophy: a single installation protects all assets 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, operating independently of human action. Its products are manufactured in SUS 316 stainless steel and high-strength polycarbonate, designed for harsh offshore environments with temperatures from -40 °C to 500 °C.

The patented Trisafe™ technology — a triple-action carabiner with automatic locking operable with one hand — eliminates human error and sets a new safety standard. With global certifications including DNVGL-RP-F107, ABS DOPP+, API RP 2D, NORSOK, and ISO 9001, Dropsafe protects people and equipment in the world's most demanding environments, backed by US$ 10 million product liability insurance.

companies.name: StopDropp
companies.tagline: Protecting the invisible. Preventing the unthinkable.
companies.description:
StopDropp develops hand tools specifically designed to prevent drops during work at height. Founded in 2005, with headquarters in Houston, Texas (USA) and Dewsbury, West Yorkshire (UK), the company is a global reference in tethered tools, tools at height, and tools aloft.

It serves the oil and gas, petrochemical, construction, mining, utilities, wind energy, and telecommunications sectors, with the goal of reducing dropped object occurrences. It is a member of organizations dedicated to drop prevention in offshore and onshore sectors.

Its product ecosystem encompasses: fixed lanyards and retractable coils with explicit Working Load Limits (WLL) for all types of tools; wearable anchor points (belts and vests with reinforced attachment points) and structural anchors; pouches and backpacks with magnetic or buckle closures, non-conductive and with multiple attachment points; plus carabiners, connectors, tool wraps, and complete kits. All products have EN 13157, ANSI/ISEA 121, ASME B30.20, and API RP 2D certifications, with load tests performed by third-party certifiers and full traceability through serialization.
